reconciliation: No source change was made. Current `source/search.html` says `sa` and `eb` do not overlap the parameter and resource ranges, with `sa` requiring the resource lower boundary to be greater than the parameter upper boundary and `eb` requiring the resource upper boundary to be less than the parameter lower boundary.
